# TIE Fighter

> A free browser space shooter with procedural low-poly ships, built with Three.js.

Fly with WASD, arrow keys, or touch controls, and fire at X-wings for 100 points
each. Three escaped enemies end a run. The game has English and Persian interfaces
and optional native Chrome WebMCP tools. A WebGL2-capable browser is required.

## Play

- [English game](https://tiefighter.cocode.dk/): Play in English.
- [Persian game](https://tiefighter.cocode.dk/fa/): Play with a Persian interface.

## Development

- [Repository](https://github.com/cocodedk/tie-fighter): Source and build instructions.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/cocodedk/tie-fighter/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Setup and checks.
- [WebMCP guide](https://github.com/cocodedk/tie-fighter/blob/main/docs/webmcp.md): Native tool setup and examples.
- [License](https://github.com/cocodedk/tie-fighter/blob/main/LICENSE): Apache-2.0.
